title: Rename run's private Herdr trait to PaneTransport, behavior-neutral
action: Pure rename so a second transport can implement run's seam under an honest name. In run.rs: rename `trait Herdr` (anchor `rg -n "^trait Herdr" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs` → 404: `trait Herdr {`) to `pub(crate) trait PaneTransport` — it has 13 methods: pane_current, pane_layout, pane_split, tab_create, pane_run, agent_start, agent_status, pane_close, agent_prompt, agent_wait, pane_alive, pane_read, process_info. Make `pub(crate)` every type those signatures mention: `enum Liveness` (384), `struct PaneGeom` (394). Keep `struct RealHerdr` (498) and `impl RealHerdr` (500) as they are; change `impl Herdr for RealHerdr` (574) to `impl PaneTransport for RealHerdr`. Rename every `&dyn Herdr` parameter to `&dyn PaneTransport` — live list from `rg -n "dyn Herdr" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs`: 965, 1480, 1520, 1759 (`fn execute(opts: &Options, herdr: &dyn Herdr) -> ExecResult`), 1767, 1806, 1877, 2141; the parameter name may stay `herdr` or become `transport`, your choice, applied consistently. Update the three test fakes from `rg -n "impl Herdr for" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs` (3165, 3287, 3520). Keep every method name, argv string and doc comment. Note in a one-line doc comment on the trait that the split lock (`split_lock::acquire` at run.rs:974) sits OUTSIDE the trait, so D2's serialization is transport-neutral. Record the test count before and after (`cargo test … herding::run 2>&1 | rg 'test result'`) in the cap proof line; they must match.
